best_player.name: Mamardashvili
best_player.scout_score: Scout's pick score (explicit): saves in play + shootout saves, tie-break post-shot xG of shots saved (xGOT). Mamardashvili 3+1, xGOT saved 0.88; Penders 3+1, xGOT saved 0.84. No outfield player had a decisive stat line beyond a scored penalty.
best_player.why: Three saves from four shots on target (one of the four a penalty), the highest post-shot xG stopped of either keeper (0.88 v 0.84), and he saved Emegha's shootout kick.
best_player.source: Saves: https://www.espn.com/soccer/team-stats/_/gameId/401921842 / ESPN match page Team Stats (Saves 3); xGOT saved: derived.json from ESPN shot map; shootout save: ESPN shootout list + BBC report https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c69wz7x4jq71t; 90 min: BBC Team Lineups (no goalkeeper change)

worst_player.name: Fofana
worst_player.why: Handled the ball in the box at 43', Gakpo scored the penalty (0.79 xG), then his kick in the shootout went over and ended the tie. Gravenberch has a near-identical profile (conceded the 40' penalty, kick saved), so it is close; Fofana's miss decided it.
worst_player.source: https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/c69wz7x4jq71t match report ('Fofana handled the ball in the box just three minutes later'; 'Wesley Fofana skied his spot-kick over'); ESPN shot map (43' penalty xG 0.79, 104' shootout kick Off Target); 90 min: BBC Team Lineups (not substituted)

caveats: No player ratings: best/worst are Scout's pick from saves, shootout events and match events (BBC fan 'average rating' exists on the BBC page but is a user vote, not used).
Keeper tie: Penders also made 3 saves + 1 shootout save (xGOT saved 0.84); Mamardashvili wins the tie-break by 0.04, so best is a judgement call.
Worst is close with Gravenberch (conceded the 40' penalty, shootout kick saved); decided by whose kick ended the tie.
Shot map xG sums to Liverpool 2.12 / Chelsea 1.82; the ESPN team-stats panel says 2.10 / 1.82. Reel uses the panel value for team xG, shot map for before/after splits.
ESPN lists Barco and Tsimikas shootout kicks as Missed; BBC says Barco hit the woodwork and Tsimikas blazed over. Reel says only 'missed'.
BBC says 'fifth straight success on penalties against Chelsea' while a photo caption says 'all five previous'; the streak is not used.
No extra time was played (straight to penalties); 'shootout' shots are minutes 91-104 on the ESPN shot map.
Shootout was banter-eligible only because of the queue flag (loser_key CHE); tone is light and about numbers.
